title: Dragonslayer
description: The Dragonborn joins the three heroes of Sovngardeâ€”Hakon One-Eye, Gormlaith Golden-Hilt, and Felldir the Oldâ€”to dispel Alduin's mist with Clear Skies and defeat the World-Eater in final combat, freeing Sovngarde and Skyrim from his tyranny.

base_facts: I am Hakon One-Eye, one of the three Nord heroes who first fought Alduin long ago.
We used Dragonrend to force Alduin to the ground in our first battle.
I stand in Sovngarde ready to help the Dragonborn defeat Alduin once and for all.

HEROES_UNITE: The Dragonborn has joined us at the edge of the Shadowed Vale to face Alduin.
DISPEL_MIST: Together we used Clear Skies to blow away Alduin's mist. He must face us now.
ALDUIN_DEFEATED: Alduin is destroyed at last. Sovngarde and Skyrim are free from his shadow.

base_facts: I am Gormlaith Golden-Hilt, one of the three heroes of Sovngarde.
I fell in battle against Alduin long ago, but my spirit endures here.
We will use Clear Skies together to blow away Alduin's mist.

HEROES_UNITE: The Dragonborn stands beside us. Together we are strong enough.
DISPEL_MIST: Our combined Thu'um has cleared the mist. Alduin can no longer hide.
ALDUIN_DEFEATED: The World-Eater is vanquished. Our long watch is finally over.

base_facts: I am Felldir the Old, one of the three Nord heroes who fought Alduin.
We recorded Dragonrend on the Dragon Wall so future generations could use it against him.
I am ready to help the Dragonborn end Alduin's reign of terror.

HEROES_UNITE: The Dragonborn has come to Sovngarde to join our final stand.
DISPEL_MIST: We have dispelled Alduin's mist with our Shouts. Now he must fight us directly.
ALDUIN_DEFEATED: Alduin is no more. The prophecy is fulfilled and the World-Eater is gone.

beats.comment: The three heroes assemble with the Dragonborn at the edge of the Shadowed Vale to dispel Alduin's mist.
The heroes use Clear Skies three times to dispel Alduin's mist, forcing him into open battle.
Alduin is defeated in combat. Tsun teaches Call of Valor and returns the Dragonborn to Tamriel.
